watches.name: MR ROBOTO BRONZO ARTIST SERIES
watches.description: With his eyes lit up, he swings his bright lantern and walks a few steps. Then, he shoots a slicing laser from his eyes and blows talc smoke! Inspired by the Lantern Robot of the 1950s, Mr. Roboto R1 from Planet Zug is a passionate revival of the tin robot generation of enthusiasts and enduring science-fiction lovers. Interact with Mr. Roboto R1, who is serious, but quirky and temperamental. He is currently on a secret mission to uncover man’s plot to replace tin robots with advanced AI robotics. He knows that one day, the AI robots will destroy mankind, and he has made up the steeliest of minds to defend men at all costs. Summoning all existing robots on earth, Mr Roboto R1 is the champion for the unification of the tin robot community. Stay by his side for the ultimate battle for and defense of the human race! Mr. Roboto R1 is always your dependable time-keeping companion. The placements lend for easy time reading despite his radical tin robot appearance. The left ‘eye’ is the hour register, the right ‘eye’ comes with the GMT indication, the ‘nose’ joins with the ‘mouth’ for the seconds and retrograde minutes placements respectively. The robust case is CNC-cut out from a hardy steel block with a warm touch of bevelled edges at the sides of the tonneau-shaped timepiece.

watches.name: BACK-IN-TIME SERIES 2
watches.description: Azimuth Watch Co. Unveils the Back in Time Series 2 – The Evolution of an Icon Azimuth's original Back in Time captivated the horology world with its debut at Baselworld 2009. As the first single-hand, counter-clockwise timepiece, it broke new ground in watchmaking, enchanting collectors and enthusiasts alike. Now, Azimuth proudly introduces the 2024 Back in Time Series 2 (BIT S2), a timepiece that celebrates 15 years of relentless pursuit of excellence in craftsmanship and innovation. Over this period, Azimuth has dedicated itself to refining its designs and enhancing the technical performance of its timepieces, ensuring that the BIT S2 is not just a continuation but a significant evolution of the original. The BIT S2 retains its signature counter-clockwise movement, with hour numerals displayed in reverse, embodying a playful yet sophisticated approach to timekeeping. This unique design is complemented by a specialized module featuring additional gear trains, enhancing the automatic movement’s precision and reliability. Key Features of the Back in Time Series 2: Premium 904L Stainless Steel: Crafted from high-grade 904L stainless steel, the BIT S2 offers exceptional corrosion resistance and a brilliant finish, ensuring both durability and elegance. The exhibition case back reveals the intricate mechanics within, showcasing Azimuth’s meticulous attention to detail. Box-Type Sapphire Crystal: The BIT S2 features a box-type sapphire crystal that provides a clear, scratch-resistant view of the dial, enhancing both durability and the overall aesthetic experience. Perfectly Balanced 41.3mm Case: At 41.3mm, the BIT S2 strikes an ideal balance between presence and sophistication, making it suitable for various occasions, from formal events to everyday wear. Innovative Movement Technology: The BIT S2 incorporates advancements in movement technology, ensuring enhanced accuracy and reliability in its unique counter-clockwise display.

watches.name: GRAN TURISMO
watches.description: Answer the call of the open road: the roar of an engine at full throttle, the rush of pushing a racing machine to its limits, the slicing wind that only comes to those fast enough – the worlds of automobiles and rallies once again serve as inspiration for Azimuth. Channeling the ferocious and fantastical spirit of motor racing for 2017, Azimuth rolls out the new Gran Turismo, a statement-making timepiece that oozes contemporary charm while paying tribute to the iconic four-wheelers of yesteryears. A sculptural work of art, the Azimuth GT is distinguished by a wholly unique case, flaunting curves that recall the profile of vintage cars, sharing the same design blueprint as its predecessor, the Twin Turbo, which was launched in 2016. Testing the aesthetic and technical limits of automobile-inspired watches, the Azimuth GT case silhouette references the curvaceous bonnets of retro Porsche 911s from the 1960s. Elsewhere, the Gran Turismo’s striking dial – positioned at an inclined angle to allow drivers to easily check the time while on the road – is a nod to the larger-than-life speedometer displays found on Mini Cooper dashboards.

watches.name: GARFIELD BITCOIN PIZZA! BACK-IN-TIME
watches.description: BITCOIN PIZZA! Azimuth launches “BITCOIN PIZZA!”, a special Garfield watch to commemorate Bitcoin Pizza Day on 22nd May Laszlo Hanyecz is the man widely believed to be the first ever person to conduct a commercial transaction using Bitcoin in 2010. Largely an experiment to see what value, if any, bitcoin had, Hanyecz, a programmer by training, offered 10,000 bitcoins via an online forum to anyone who could bring him two Papa John’s pizzas. When Bitcoin was first mined in 2009, it was basically worthless, or at best a fraction of a penny. No one had ever actually spent a bitcoin before, so the prices were largely based on theoretical value. Fast forward to 2022; at the point of this press release these 2 pizzas would have been valued at approximately US$400,000,000. THE GARFIELD LIMITED EDITION TIMEPIECE This collector’s item depicts Garfield, a global pop-culture icon, running away with a slice of pizza and sporting a cheeky smile. Azimuth is proud to bring Garfield into the world of haute Horlogerie with this quirky timepiece, and we are certain that both Azimuth and Garfield fans who are self-confident, want comfort, and have that swagger-like attitude can certainly relate to Azimuth’s philosophy of watchmaking!

watches.name: LAND CRUISER -THE DARK SIDE
watches.description: Could This be the Machine to Save Mankind? The Land Cruiser embarks on a secret mission to uncover a threatening element. The Land Cruiser embarks on a highly classified military project to a newly formed planet 500 light years away. This planet harbours an elusive, highly unstable element, code name XX2 which holds the potential to release an unprecedented amount of cosmic energy and is predicted to alter the pathway of planet earth. A rugged hovercraft with off-road capabilities, the Land Cruiser is tasked on this urgent mission to trek challenging terrains in uncharted territories, ranging from rocky landscapes to sandy deserts to ascertain the characteristics of this newly discovered element. And time is running out. Could this machine be the only hope to save mankind? Only time will tell… The creation of the Land Cruiser is a testament to Azimuth’s enduring love affair between imagination and science fiction, fused into the realm of horology. 4 years in the making, the Land Cruiser carries the DNA of its predecessor, the SP-1 Landship created in 2010, which was inspired by the World War I military tank. The Land Cruiser comes stacked with interesting functions reflecting the original designs of the Landship. Time is told by the domed wondering hour at the 12 o’clock position and the slanted retrograde minute aperture at the 6 o’clock position.

watches.name: FROST GOLD RETROGRADE MINUTES
watches.description: Watches with a retrograde display show time in an arc manner, instead of in a circular fashion. The hand in a retrograde display travels along an arc and when it gets to the end of the scale, jumps back to the beginning and starts counting again. In the Azimuth RRM Frost, the hour hand is set in a small circle on the left side of the dial with the retrograde minute hand traversing gracefully on the bottom right. With Azimuth Regulator Retrograde Frost, you can literally dance with time.

watches.name: CRAZY RIDER
watches.description: An off-kilter creation for the soul hungry for speed, adventure and freedom, the Crazy Rider does not disappoint through its offering of motoring pizzazz. The first thing that strikes you about the watch is its unusual case. Constructed to resemble a motorcycle engine, the case’s asymmetrical, infinity symbol-shaped profile sets the tone for the rest of the timepiece. Fitted with a porthole-style bezel with exposed screws, Crazy Rider invites you to peer into its inner workings, akin to looking deep at the cross-section of an engine. A miniature chain circles the centre of the dial, aided by open-worked wheels at both ends, this time evoking the look of a motorcycle’s sprocket brake drive system. This ingenious chain transmission design, in fact, drives the hour and minute display. The shorter hour hand traverses along the entire dial, indicating time along a true 24-hour scale. Meantime, the minute hand rotates from a fixed position at right end of the wheel.

watches.name: PREDATOR 2.0
watches.description: The 2019 Predator 2.0 is the result of the long-running love affair between Azimuth and the world of science fiction – an obsession that has birthed some of the watch marque’s most iconic collections such as Mr. Roboto, Spaceship, and Twin Turbo. Marrying state-of-the-art case construction, unique material treatment and contemporary design, the Predator 2.0 is a direct descendant of Azimuth’s popular Spaceship collection, known for its spacecraft-inspired aesthetics, as well as ingenious jumping hour display complemented by a highly stylised, broad minute hand. Expressing Azimuth’s uncompromising spirit of invention, the Predator 2.0 spaceship cockpit-inspired look is anchored by a two-part case. It comprises an inner capsule and an outer chassis with lugs. Currently available in full titanium, and stainless steel, the modular case construction offers endless possibilities for new designs with the opportunity to experiment with different combinations of materials, finishing and surface treatments. The design of the Predator 2.0 evokes a time and place that is of the future. The oversized crown at 12 o’clock, instead of the typical position at three o’clock; the subtly faceted surfaces on the case; the domed sapphire crystal cover; and newly redesigned massive titanium hands shaped like intergalactic weapons all combine to lend the watch an otherworldly, sci-fi-inspired disposition.

watches.name: SPACESHIP BLUE AVENTURINE
watches.description: Capable of navigating the intergalactic dimensions at light speed, The Spaceship specialises in bringing humans on whimsical horological excursions. A breathtakingly sculptural masterpiece, the SP-1 Mécanique mimics the profile of a spacecraft’s cockpit. Its 45mm stainless steel case with elongated lugs is capped by a domed sapphire crystal, which lends the watch a multi-dimensional look. The enigmatic dark blue dial is showered with interstellar stardust, collected from the tiny specks of radiating stars on a clear night. Matching the mesmerising dial design is its equally ingenious jumping hour display. Powered by a Unitas 6497-1 movement with the Côtes de Genève decoration, a rotating disc framed by the short end of the three-dimensional minute hand, a jumping hour complication is presented as part of The Spaceship’s engine. Highly stylised, the broad minute hand comes finished with a skeleton outline that resembles a space shuttle hurtling across the universe.

watches.name: MR. ROBOTO R2
watches.description: Rrrrrrring… Domo Arigato, Mr. Roboto, please pick up the call… Your friendly robot time butler, Mr. Roboto R2, is at your service! Inspired by the Golden Robot of the 1950s, R2 is a morphed version of his cousin, R1. Expect a new machine with a bolder design cues. You can never miss the handsome Mr. Roboto R2 with his well-defined features – he boasts an aesthetic upgrade with 3D eyes and a mouth that reveals the depths of the complications within its machinery system. Sporting a robust steel body that is larger than its predecessors, Mr. Roboto R2 feels sturdier and more substantial on one’s wrist. R2’s left eye shows the hour register while its right eye shows the GMT indication. With an endearing smile, its mouth displays a retrograde minute counter. Witness the perfect marriage of ingenious design and user-friendly functions, where the enlarged left eye shows the hour register while the right eye the GMT indication. The mouth displays a retrograde minute counter. Mr. Roboto R2 is hooked up with a brand new heart – an Azimuth-developed movement beating at a heart rate of 28,800vph. He has a mystery sapphire automatic rotor that is enlarged to ensure that his power reserve is ramped up fast to its peak efficiency to perform his robotic task of precision time recording.

watches.description: It looks normal. But looks can be deceiving. Take a few seconds to look at the timepiece, and you will realise something extremely, extremely strange. There is only an hour hand. Time is told backwards, and by backwards, we mean the hour hand moves anti-clockwise. An understated dress watch with a silent power to manipulate time, Back In Time is the perfect subtle touch that will give the wearer an aura of quiet confidence. An in-house modified ETA movement powers this unique Azimuth-designed movement with special gearings for anticlockwise motion. Power reserve is approximately 40 hours. The case (42mm) is made of 316L stainless steel and topped with a domed sapphire crystal.

watches.name: TWIN BARREL TOURBILLON
watches.description: A hardcore contemporary timepiece, the Twin Barrel Tourbillon (TBT) represents a brand new era of micro-machine making. To counter the headwind, the TBT is streamlined by drawing inspiration from the silhouettes and raw muscle power of the various marques in the high-end supercar market. The tourbillon feature gets you in the lead by countering the effects of gravity – there is nothing left in your way. Fashioned and CNC-cut from a solid block of titanium, the ultra-lightweight case is adorned with plates of carbon fibre fitted into the recesses at the sides and back of the case. At the 6 o’clock position beats a massive Tourbillon mechanism with the KIF shock absorption system, which acts as the “suspension” for the balance staff and the massive cage. To reduce drag on the movement, the twin discs and the massive arm are constructed from titanium. After multiple tests and refinement, the TBT is finally presented to you as a perfect time-keeping equivalent to your treasured supercar.

It jumps into worm holes without hesitation, and never stops searching for the rarest, most precious materials in space. The Predator of the extra-terrestrial world blends futuristic complications onto a fully functional timepiece. The hour hand moves like a majestic spacecraft orbiting about a mechanical space station, while a specially selected domed sapphire crystal highlights the intricacy of the inner mechanisms through the exposed skeleton movement. The newly redesigned massive titanium hands shaped like intergalactic weapons all combine with The Predator’s engine to lend the watch an otherworldly disposition. Marrying state-of-the-art case construction, unique material treatment and contemporary design, The Predator 2.0 is a direct descendant of Azimuth’s signature Spaceship collection, known for its spacecraft-inspired aesthetics, as well as ingenious jumping hour display complemented by a highly stylised, broad minute hand. The Predator comprises an inner capsule and an outer chassis with lugs, and is powered by a hand-wound caliber. The watch’s bridges are crafted in aluminium, which accords the movement an incredible lightness that is similar to the weightlessness that astronauts experience in space.

watches.name: GRAND BACCARAT ENTRY
watches.description: The Azimuth Grand Baccarat is a unique watch known for its "Baccarat game" feature, allowing you to play a round of baccarat by pushing the crown. It's a collaboration between Azimuth and Marina Bay Sands, often featuring a special edition with mother-of-pearl dials and various embellishments like diamonds and gems. The watch is typically Swiss automatic movement, with a modified in-house movement for the baccarat game functionality.

watches.name: TWIN TURBO
watches.description: Rev up your engines and get ready for a watch that provokes your senses. Debuting the Twin Turbo, loaded with technical and design bravado, made especially for the individual that carries a passion for the vintage. With the well-grinded race tracks giving the nod to this timepiece, Twin Turbo’s striking design features its sculptured case design that resembles the sexy silhouette of the 60s vintage racing cars. But what is truly its high-octane appeal is the mechanism that lies underneath the watch cover – a re-engineered case construction that mimics the technical construction of the car bonnet, which gives the wearer an intimate engagement as he flips it up to reveal the engine block. Powered by a rare vintage calibre from the 1960s, the manual-winding movement faithfully mirrors the gearbox system of the yesteryears automotive technology. The dials of the Twin Turbo take their design cues from vintage speedometers on the dashboard, which offers the wearer two time-zone readings at a glance.

watches.name: AZIMUTH WOOD DRAGON
watches.description: Azimuth Watch, a leading name in horology, proudly introduces The Dragon, a distinctive timepiece that seamlessly weaves together the essence of Chinese zodiac symbolism and masterful craftsmanship. The Dragon is a unique ode to the Chinese zodiac's twelve animals, although only the majestic Dragon takes centre stage on the twelve o'clock marker. The remaining indices showcase Chinese numerals, intricately engraved to celebrate the cultural richness and symbolic significance of the zodiac. In homage to the Year of the Dragon, The Dragon's dial features a rich forest green hue, representing the Wood Element associated with this mythical creature. Crafted from precious malachite, the green dial captures the essence of the dragon while offering a visually striking and meaningful design. Setting itself apart from conventional timepieces, The Dragon employs an intricate engraving technique for the Chinese numerals on the dial. The numerals are delicately engraved onto a disc made of a lustrous, mahogany-toned ceramic ring, infusing the watch with an air of sophistication.

watches.name: THE BILLIONAIRE'S WATCH
watches.description: Two prominent moons and fourteen stars subtly adorn the dial, forming an enigmatic constellation that hints at a deeper, carefully guarded meaning — inviting intrigue and admiration. As Bobby puts it, “Never let your girlfriend disrespect your wife. ” This audacious sentiment echoes the complex dynamics and respect that underscore the constellation ’ s symbolism. This exceptional timepiece is born from a visionary partnership that merges rich cultural symbolism with modern haute horlogerie. Inspired by Indo-Chinese traditions and Bobby Saputra’s personal legacy, The Billionaire’s Watch is crafted for those who transcend conventional luxury. Two prominent moons and fourteen stars subtly adorn the dial, forming an enigmatic constellation that hints at a deeper, carefully guarded meaning — inviting intrigue and admiration.

watches.name: SP-1 KING CASINO
watches.description: The Azimuth King Casino is a roulette-inspired wristwatch known for its unique, playful design and focus on visual mechanics. It features a dice-shaped crown that activates a spinning ball on a miniature roulette wheel dial, visible under a high-domed sapphire crystal. The watch is a larger, bolder evolution of Azimuth's earlier SP-1 Roulette model, incorporating elements inspired by Baccarat as well.

watches.name: MECHA-1 CHRONO GAUGE BMF
watches.description: Defying conventions and setting new standards, the Mecha-1 Chrono Gauge combines contemporary styling with fine Swiss craftsmanship. Taking its design cues from the iconic Porsche 911 of the 1980s, the sub-counters takes the shape of the car’s dashboard, presenting a fine work of art bundled in a wrist-sized package. The Porsche 911 has been highly contested throughout the decade as a car model that went against. But it is this very anomaly that resounded with Azimuth, a champion for all things that are unconventional. The Chrono-Gauge BMF is thus birthed as a tribute to this very car model that went beyond every imaginable constraint to emerge as one of the most outstanding cars of the decade. True to 911’s behaviour on the roads, the Chrono-Gauge BMF is subdued. Powerfully subdued. Its energy is kept contained within the raw powdered and accentuated curves of the tonneau-shaped case. Minutes are displayed in retrograde form on a horizontal arc, and chronograph, hours, minutes on four sub dials. The Torx drive cheese-head tamper-resistant screws, stylised crown and five unique sapphire crystal windows complete the look, resulting in a timepiece that embodies the winning signatures of the Porsche 911.

watches.name: XTREME-1 Deep Diver
watches.description: The Azimuth Xtreme-1 Deep Diver is a high-end, robust dive watch known for its extreme water resistance (2000m) and unique design. It features a large 46mm titanium case, a double-domed sapphire crystal, and a unidirectional bezel with Super Luminova markers. The watch utilises an automatic movement, specifically the ETA 2826-2, which is encased in a movement capsule and further protected by an anti-magnetic dust cover.

watches.name: MR. ROBOTO BRONZO
watches.description: With a killer bod to die for, Mr. Roboto Bronzo lands on Planet Earth with a whizz, a bang, and a blinding light! Descending from a family of warriors of the Planet Fuku, the overly-muscular Mr. Roboto Bronzo is equipped with an armour-shield body, that is bullet proof, cosmic proof and most importantly, highly pleasing to the ladies’ eyes. Powered by steam from the condensation of water of Planet Earth’s, and helium gas from his birth planet, Mr. Roboto Bronzo is a magnificent sight to behold. As defender of the Tin Robot movement, he was summoned by Mr. Roboto R1 to prepare for the Armageddon between AI robots and the tin robots. Boasting the best of technologies from Planet Fuku, Mr. Roboto Bronzo’s state-of-the-art advanced analogue electronics acts as the main communication model for the united tin robot community. As the tin robots prepare for battle, this commandeering leader stands tall at the forefront of the infantry line. He is righteous, fearless, and lethal. Powered with extra horsepower, Mr. Roboto Bronzo is ever ready to trek through the roughest of terrains, and harshest of environment. With his acute killer instincts and the intense firepower from his eyes, mouth and hands, the AI robots are in for a tough battle.

specsRaw.Movement: automatic, in-house modified, 28,800vph; ø 32.5 mm, height 6.7 mm
specsRaw.Case: bronze, 43 mm x 50 mm, sapphire crystal, water-resistant to 3 atm

watches.name: BACK-IN-TIME “SAVE THE 1"
watches.description: Championing greater environmental awareness, Azimuth is proud to introduce an expressive work of horological art- the new Back-In-Time (BIT) ‘Earth Vision – Save The 1’ Limited Edition, a collection that invites us to think about the world we live in. Looking deceptively normal, the hour numerals are depicted in reverse, while the hour and minute hands journey in anti-clockwise direction, portraying time as if it is moving backwards. This capricious technical trick is achieved via a module with additional gear trains mounted on top of the automatic movement. Radiating at the heart of the BIT ‘Earth Vision – Save The 1’ timepieces are the gorgeous dials that flaunt miniscule ripple patterns; inspired by the dynamic movements of nature, evoking the gentle waves of the ocean or the rustling of leaves in a breeze. Awash in gradated shades of blue for the ‘Ocean Blue’ model, and green for the ‘Rainforest’ variant, each dial is fastidiously constructed. The dials first undergo a highly precise machine-stamping process to create the guilloche wave-like pattern. After stamping, they are lavished with blue or green paint, hand-sprayed by master artisans to accord a gradated ‘fumé’ effect that is smooth and flawless. A painstaking process, each layer of colour must be dried before the artisans can apply the next coat to achieve the colour graduation effect.

specsRaw.Movement: automatic, in-house modified, 28,800vph, ø 34.4mm, height 4.50mm
specsRaw.Case: bronze, ø 42mm, height 14.4mm, domed sapphire crystal, water-resistant to 3 atm

watches.name: RETROGRADE MINUTES MOP FIRE DRAGON
watches.description: In 2008, Azimuth created the first Round-1 Dragon RRM using a single piece of fragile mother-of-pearl, thick enough to be engraved on, to create the magnificent three-dimensional etching of a majestic dragon. The naturally luminescent mother-of-pearl face set aglow the precision cut detail of each rippling scale on Azimuth’s oriental dragon, while a retrograde timescale that sat atop the dragon’s serpentine body lashed out the minutes with precise mechanisation. Only 25 pieces of each colour were produced and became a hit with every one of collectors for its realistic dragon depiction and innovative use of the retrograde mechanism. Watches with a retrograde display show time in an arc manner, instead of in a circular fashion. The hand in a retrograde display travels along an arc and when it gets to the end of the scale, jumps back to the beginning and starts counting again. In the Azimuth Round-1 RRM Dragon, the hour hand is set in a small circle at the top left of the dial, while the minutes curve along the body of the dragon. The second hand is the only hand that travels around the whole face of the watch. Azimuth’s first Round-1 RRM Dragon with the white mother-of-pearl dial represents the water element, while our second production presented the earth element through a reflective brown dial etched with the rays of the sun. A small white mother-of-pearl dial that tells the hours is set atop the brown dial, while the eyes of the dragon are set aglow with a touch of red to bring life to this majestic beast. The variant ends with the final two RRM Dragons presenting the fire and gold elements, through the use of red and yellow colour symbols respectively.

watches.name: MR. ROBOTO SAPPHIRE
watches.description: Azimuth is a highly innovative and avant-garde Swiss watchmaking brand founded by Alvin Lye and Christopher Long in 2003. Azimuth is known for its unconventional and boundary-pushing approach to watch design, often creating timepieces that resemble mechanical toys more than traditional wristwatches. This year Azimuth is delighted to unveil Mr. Roboto Sapphire, a 20-piece limited-edition masterpiece that epitomizes the company's commitment to innovation and excellence. Mr. Roboto Sapphire is a fusion of mechanical artistry and contemporary aesthetics. Its defining feature is the stunning sapphire crystal case, made possible only after a series of numerous complex machining operations and under the hands of a highly skilled polisher. The sapphire crystal case not only encases the intricate mechanical movement and showcases the mesmerising inner workings of the watch but also offers exceptional durability and scratch resistance, ensuring that the Mr. Roboto Sapphire will stand the test of time. Another highlight of this timepiece is the dial, which is individually crafted from a solid block of Damasus Steel, a material that was notably used for fine sword making in 1100 A.D.

watches.name: MR. ROBOTO R1
watches.description: With his eyes lit up, he swings his bright lantern and walks a few steps. Then, he shoots a slicing laser from his eyes and blows talc smoke! Inspired by the Lantern Robot of the 1950s, Mr. Roboto R1 from Planet Zug is a passionate revival of the tin robot generation of enthusiasts and enduring science-fiction lovers. Interact with Mr. Roboto R1, who is serious, but quirky and temperamental. He is currently on a secret mission to uncover man’s plot to replace tin robots with advanced AI robotics. He knows that one day, the AI robots will destroy mankind, and he has made up the steeliest of minds to defend men at all costs. Summoning all existing robots on earth, Mr Roboto R1 is the champion for the unification of the tin robot community. Stay by his side for the ultimate battle for and defense of the human race! Mr. Roboto R1 is always your dependable time-keeping companion. The placements lend for easy time reading despite his radical tin robot appearance. The left ‘eye’ is the hour register, the right ‘eye’ comes with the GMT indication, the ‘nose’ joins with the ‘mouth’ for the seconds and retrograde minutes placements respectively. The robust case is CNC-cut out from a hardy steel block with a warm touch of bevelled edges at the sides of the tonneau-shaped timepiece.

watches.name: SPACESHIP PREDATOR LAVA OVERLAND
watches.description: SPACESHIP PREDATOR LAVA OVERLAND, a Volcano Exploration Machine with the ability to withstand extreme temperatures and go back in time to capture the moments of earth’s creation. The 2021 SPACESHIP PREDATOR LAVA OVERLAND is the result of the long-running love affair between Azimuth and the world of science fiction – an obsession that has birthed some of the watch marque’s most iconic collections such as Mr. Roboto, Spaceship, and Twin Turbo. Marrying state-of-the-art case construction, unique material treatment and contemporary design, the SPACESHIP PREDATOR LAVA OVERLAND is a direct descendant of Azimuth’s popular Spaceship collection, known for its spacecraft-inspired aesthetics, as well as ingenious jumping hour display complemented by a highly stylised, broad minute hand. Expressing Azimuth’s uncompromising spirit of invention, the SPACESHIP PREDATOR LAVA OVERLAND cockpit-inspired look is anchored by a two-part case. It comprises an inner capsule and an outer chassis with lugs. CNC cut in bronze, the modular case construction offers endless possibilities for new designs with the opportunity to experiment with different combinations of materials, finishing and surface treatments.
